sections.title: Advanced Trigonometry Concepts
sections.content: Level 3 covers general angles, trigonometric equations, multiple-angle formulas, complex identities, and their applications in problem-solving beyond basic triangles.

sections.title: Solving Trigonometric Equations
sections.content: Equations like sinx = a, cosx = b, tanx = c are solved using identities and double/half-angle formulas. Example: sin2x = √3/2 → 2x = 60°, 120° → x = 30°, 60°

sections.title: Advanced Identities and Transformations
sections.content: Expressing sin³A, cos³A in terms of first powers: sin³A = (3 sinA - sin3A)/4, cos³A = (3 cosA + cos3A)/4. Also use sum, difference, and product formulas for simplification.

sections.title: Triangle Area and Ratios
sections.content: Area of triangle ABC = 1/2 * a * b * sinC. Law of Sines: a/sinA = b/sinB = c/sinC. Law of Cosines: c² = a² + b² - 2ab cosC.

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
1. Forgetting identities
2. Ignoring multiple solutions in equations
3. Confusing degrees and radians

sections.title: Quick Summary
sections.content: Remember identities, equations, area and ratio formulas. Solve stepwise and always check all possible solutions.

tricks.title: Memorize General Angles
tricks.explanation: Keep sin, cos, tan values for angles like 15°, 75°, 105°, 165° for fast calculations

tricks.title: Equation Solving Shortcut
tricks.explanation: sinx = a → x = sin⁻¹a + 360°n or 180°-sin⁻¹a + 360°n, cosx = b → x = cos⁻¹b + 360°n or -cos⁻¹b + 360°n

tricks.title: Simplifying sin³ and cos³
tricks.explanation: Use sin³A = (3 sinA - sin3A)/4, cos³A = (3 cosA + cos3A)/4 for quicker calculation

tricks.title: Fast Area Calculation
tricks.explanation: Area = 1/2 * a * b * sinC directly for triangles

tricks.title: Sine and Cosine Law Shortcut
tricks.explanation: a/sinA = b/sinB = c/sinC, c² = a² + b² - 2ab cosC

tricks.title: Consider All Possible Solutions
tricks.explanation: For sin and cos equations, always check both solutions

tricks.title: High-Level Identities Memorization
tricks.explanation: tan(A+B)= (tanA+tanB)/(1-tanA tanB), tan3A=(3 tanA - tan³A)/(1-3 tan²A) for faster calculations
